description:
Circle K in countries: Norway, Denmark, Sweden, Poland, Lithuania, Latvia, Estonia

On the road? Our app has you covered! Enjoy a range of digital services that keep evolving to give you the best Circle K experience - all in one place. We’ve also improved our loyalty program, Circle K extra! Your fuel and charging discounts now depend on how often you visit—whether it’s for fuel, charging, snacks, or just a coffee. Plus, you get to choose your own reward every 5th visit!
-	Track your progress and rewards in Circle K extra View your discount level, pick personalized rewards, and easily manage your purchase history, linked cards, and communication preferences.
-	Pay with our app at the pump Pay for fuel quickly and securely in the app.
-	Need a car wash? No problem! Use the app to wash your car at your nearest Circle K and keep it sparkling clean.
-	Car wash subscriptions Sign in or sign up for flexible wash programs to suit every need.
-	Find your nearest station Locate Circle K stations and filter by services like car wash, EV charging and more.

Circle K in Germany, Belgium and Luxembourg:

With the Circle K App, you have everything you need on the go: Quickly find Circle K stations, TotalEnergies branded station, as well as stations from participating partners within the acceptance network, discover current in-station offers, and enjoy the benefits of the Reward Club – all in one app.
Add your Reward Card digitally and enjoy exclusive benefits anytime, without carrying a physical card. Whether you’re commuting or traveling, the Circle K App supports you on every journey.

Your benefits at a glance:
-	Overview of Circle K stations and participating partner stations
-	Add your Reward Card digitally in the app
-	Enjoy all benefits of the Reward Club
-	Discover current offers and promotions at stations
-	Mini Games
The Circle K App – simple, practical, and always with you.

Circle K expands its network
In 2023, Alimentation Couche-Tard acquired the TotalEnergies station network in Germany and the Netherlands, while taking a stake acquisition in Belgium and Luxembourg, expanding its European presence by nearly 2,200 locations.
Fuel will continue to be offered under the TotalEnergies brand for the time being, while Circle K services and upgrades are introduced gradually. Alimentation Couche-Tard is a global leader in convenience and mobility, with nearly 17,300 stores in 29 countries and over 5,200 stations across Europe under the Circle K and INGO brands.
